company.name: Evai Analytics
company.shortDescription: Evai Analytics is a crypto valuation platform that provides information about investment strategies for crypto assets.
company.description: Evai is a fintech and Web3 analytics platform that provides AI-driven cryptocurrency ratings, portfolio analysis, and market intelligence tools for digital assets. Founded in 2019, the company focuses on evaluating crypto assets using machine learning models, liquidity metrics, and risk analysis to help users assess market performance and volatility. Its platform offers ratings, trading insights, and portfolio optimization tools covering cryptocurrencies, DeFi assets, and related blockchain markets. The company also developed the EV token ecosystem tied to platform features and community participation.

productsAndServices.description: A system that ranks cryptocurrencies from AAA to D based on their suitability for inclusion in optimal investment portfolios using AI-driven analysis of market factors.
